project_overview.description: Production-grade automatic rotoscoping pipeline using SAM2, GroundingDINO, and Depth Anything V2
project_overview.purpose: Generate professional-quality alpha mattes from video clips for VFX compositing
project_overview.primary_output: 16-bit EXR alpha sequences for Nuke/After Effects

v5_enhancements.summary: Professional VFX quality modules implementing industry-standard compositing techniques

new_modules.name: edge_refine.py
new_modules.purpose: Professional edge refinement with subpixel precision
key_features: Subpixel edge detection using Laplacian-of-Gaussian at 4x resolution
Morphological gradient for precise edge band extraction
Premultiplied alpha operations for proper compositing math
Soft falloff generation with gamma curves
Core shrink and edge extend operations

new_modules.name: temporal_smooth.py
key_features: Optical flow estimation using Farneback algorithm
Keyframe anchoring to prevent long-term drift
Anti-flicker processing with max delta limiting

new_modules.name: matte_combine.py
new_modules.purpose: Multi-layer matte architecture and professional compositing
key_features: Professional blend modes (over, under, max, min, screen, multiply, etc.)
Light wrap simulation for natural composites
Proper OVER operation with premultiplied alpha

new_modules.name: full_pipeline_v5.py
new_modules.purpose: Integrated pipeline chaining all v5 stages

architectural_decisions.rationale: Professional compositing separates core (solid interior), detail (hair/transparency), and soft edge (anti-aliased boundary) for independent control
Motion-compensated filtering prevents edge flickering while preserving motion detail
architectural_decisions.chosen_because: Farneback flow is fast and provides per-pixel motion vectors

architectural_decisions.rationale: 4x upscaling with LoG detection provides anti-aliased edges without artifacts
architectural_decisions.chosen_because: Balanced quality vs compute, works on any GPU

architectural_decisions.rationale: Industry standard for compositing - preserves edge color, enables proper over/screen operations
Sampling FG/BG colors at edge bands allows refined alpha calculation based on color proximity
architectural_decisions.chosen_because: Works well for varied content, no additional model required
